protocol.purpose: One bounded ESC candidate screen; reuse previously frozen WMSR pilot as reference after batch1 re-evaluation
protocol.scheduler: Linear warmup100 then constantLR; pilot horizon1000, not a scaled claim of official500k recipe

protocol.implementation: Official pinned ESC standard, native Naive FP32 attention, registry wiring skipped only; native evalbatch1; no custom CUDA patch or pretrained weights; cache derived integerRPE indices onGPU, verified loss/output/parameter-gradient equivalence
